warnings: Three details on one sheet, resolving the two callouts made from A-16 (ดูขยาย 1 and 2) and the one made from A-05 and A-08 (ฐานเสา ดูแบบขยาย).

*** THE STAIR IS FINISHED IN FIBRE CEMENT, NOT THE BARE CONCRETE THE STRUCTURAL SET DETAILS. *** ขยาย 1 specifies ลูกนอนไฟเบอร์ซีเมนต์ 1"x12" treads and ลูกตั้งไฟเบอร์ซีเมนต์ 1" risers over the RC flight from S-14, with a stainless balustrade (1 1/2" handrail and newels, 1" intermediate rails). A quantity take-off must count both the RC and the boarding.
Tread 0.275 and riser 0.15 on this sheet agree exactly with A-16, and the 0.025 nosing projection is added here.
BOTH RAILINGS ARE 0.90 M HIGH. That is the STAIR figure; A-03 sets the RAMP rail at 0.80 m above the ramp surface. Two different heights for two different places -- do not merge them.

The column-base enlargement is a 0.50 x 0.50 encasement round the 0.20 x 0.20 RC column, set 0.10 off centre, with a 0.62 m shaft and a 0.05 m cap. The entrance steps at +0.10 / +0.25 / +0.38 run past it, matching the site plan and A-05.

*** TWO DIFFERENT GROOVES EXIST IN THIS SET AND THEY ARE EASY TO CONFUSE: *** the facade banding on A-08/A-09 is 'แนวเซาะร่อง กว้าง 1 ซม ลึก 1 ซม', while the pier here is 'เซาะร่องกว้าง 5 ซม ลึก 1.5 ซม' -- five times wider. Both are recorded with their own dimensions.
